principle_violations.reason: The UserService class is directly dependent on a specific database implementation (MySQLDatabase), which makes it difficult to modify or replace the database without changing this class.
principle_violations.suggestion: Introduce an abstraction interface for database operations, and make UserService depend on this interface instead of MySQLDatabase. This will allow for easy swapping of database implementations.
